text:
Usually yes. Over a full lifetime, an electric car typically emits less CO2 than a comparable petrol car.

- Building an EV emits more at first, mainly because of the battery.
- It makes that up while driving, because running on electricity emits less than burning petrol.
- How big the advantage is depends on the local electricity grid: large on clean grids, much smaller on coal-heavy ones.
